山姆与火车站的计划(Sam and the the train station: 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:山姆与欧文的经历和小计划。
The hotel is one of the best places in the city. Owen is interested in singing. Sam drinks water after doing sports. Also, I study English on Tuesday evening.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the hotel by bike. There are always many people at the train station. The weather was sunny that day. Best of all, no vehicles are allowed in the old street.
Both of them like soup and water. Sam hopes to visit Paris one day. Owen's birthday is in September. What's more, we take a walk on the beach.
Sam's favorite animal is the cat. Last Saturday, Sam and Owen went to the hotel. Sam wrote about the day in the diary.
